assertions.name: 1_three_distinct_values
assertions.detail: 3 distinct values at the anchor audit's own 14-char discrimination width (_MATCH_PREFIX), which is what it uses to tell muon from proton

assertions.name: 2_separations_exceed_L1_target
assertions.detail: every pairwise separation exceeds the L1 compute target of 1 ppQ = 1e-15 relative = 1e-6 ppb, so this is not arithmetic noise

assertions.name: 3_separations_below_mu_p_tension
assertions.detail: all three sit INSIDE the ~11.5 ppb muon-proton gap, so none of them is a mislabelled proton value — this is a muon-vs-muon discrepancy, a class the anchor vocabulary has no way to express

assertions.name: 4_B_is_the_reverted_derivation_value
assertions.detail: B matches the number `_q0_value_for_anchor`'s docstring records as the WRONG side of the 2026-08-15 revert ('1.1099785955541805 stamped'). The revert fixed the code and left the data, so B survives on main.

assertions.name: 5a_live_resolver_returns_C_not_A
assertions.detail: _q0_value_for_anchor('muon') derives from q_muon_at() since bean qou-tekx stage 3b, so it returns C. This probe bound its `A` to that call and therefore labelled C as A until 2026-09-14; the binding is now a literal and this assertion is what would catch the drift again.

assertions.name: 5b_live_derivation_agrees_with_the_resolver
assertions.detail: q_muon_at(60) and _q0_value_for_anchor('muon') are the two doors onto 'the muon pin'. bean qou-2361 recorded them DISAGREEING (code on C, anchor witness on A); they now agree, so that split is closed on the read path.

assertions.name: 5c_A_matches_no_CODATA_vintage
assertions.detail: inverting A gives m_mu/m_e = 206.768282989315, which matches NEITHER published figure and sits strictly between them (5.17e-11 from 2018, 1.40e-9 from 2022). So 'A is just the old CODATA' is measurably FALSE — A is not reproducible from a published muon ratio at all.

assertions.name: 5_C_is_not_B
assertions.detail: q_muon_at() no longer returns what it returned when these witnesses were written — it derives over a CODATA input and drifts as that input updates, while A is frozen. Two moving targets, one fixed.

description: Three distinct values are all called 'the muon q0' and differ at the 13th significant digit: the frozen canonical pin, the value left inside four probe witnesses by a code change that was reverted without regenerating them, and today's live q_muon_at() derivation, which has drifted again since. All three sit inside the 11.5 ppb muon-proton gap, so this is a muon-vs-muon discrepancy the anchor vocabulary cannot currently express.
computation_method: A, B and C are DEFINED, not discovered: B and C from the lepton-tower inversion q0 = 1/(1-sqrt(Vol(4_1)/(m_mu/m_e))) at CODATA 2018 and 2022, A as the literal it has to be because no published ratio reproduces it (assertion 5c). The two live doors — _q0_value_for_anchor('muon') and q_muon_at(60) — are then CHECKED against C rather than used as sources, which is the binding that silently broke. Survival counts are a live walk of the committed witnesses, replacing a hardcoded four-file inventory that had gone stale. Exact-decimal mpmath; no float64.
q0AnchorReason: Muon-layer throughout: every value compared is a muon q0 and the canonical muon pin is the reference. No proton quantity is read, so this is not a cross-anchor comparison and not a layer straddle.
scope: scope-(a) MEASUREMENT, not a ruling. Does not say which value is correct, changes no pin, wires nothing. Choosing between A and C is an owner/registry question about what the ideal CAL-2 muon pin means; regenerating the B-carrying witnesses is a separate migration.

codata_reconstruction.note: B = CODATA 2018, C = CODATA 2022 — the same inline derivation q0 = 1/(1-sqrt(Vol(4_1)/(m_mu/m_e))) at two vintages, with commit a4d9906659 (codata_2022_source.py) the step between. A matches no vintage.

result.verdict: Three values, two of them moving. The 2026-08-15 revert of the derive-the-muon-branch change was complete in the code and incomplete in the data, and q_muon_at() has drifted again on top of that. Until it is ruled which of A and C a 'muon-anchored' quantity should use, a producer that calls q_muon_at() cannot be honestly stamped against the canonical pin -- the audit correctly reports Q0_FLIP, and stamping the constant instead would make its per-leg check a tautology.
